about: What this phase (the owner's brief of 2026-10-08, 'Finish The Open Work, Improve Navigation, And Build The Connected Entertainment Industry') can do, one capability a row, each held to the code by tools/capabilities.mjs: every command, look, route and file it names must exist. Status is one of Missing, Partial, Implemented, Verified, Blocked: Verified means a test or a run in the built app shows the outcome, not only that code exists. The four layers are kept apart: a field in the model (schema) is not content, content is not a working interaction, and an interaction is not verified behavior. The denominator is these rows, this phase's scope, not all of SLATE and not all of real life or of IMDb. Since the owner's scope reset of 2026-10-09 every row of this phase but kept-context is Retired: the career, the industry, its database and the rail went, and the rows stay as the record of what was built.

capabilities.goal: Be introduced to an agency by your manager or a casting office you met
capabilities.entry: Career, Representation, Seeking Representation: Ask Your Manager To Introduce You; Ask <Office> To Introduce You
capabilities.preconditions: Career begun, headshots; a manager (American agencies only), or a casting office met at a workshop where you work within two years, once a year each
capabilities.effects: None in time or money; answered in 10 (manager) or 14 (casting) days
capabilities.provenance: research-schedule-series-voice-commercial.json (SAG-AFTRA FAQ, Backstage: managers and casting directors introduce); weights SLATE's estimate
capabilities.manual: Seen in the built app's agency table
capabilities.limits: Retired by the owner's scope reset of 2026-10-09; it was Verified. A producer's or a lawyer's introduction isn't a route

capabilities.goal: A series' season moved, a hiatus, a call moved, its order cut or called off
capabilities.entry: Career, Work: the change under the job
capabilities.preconditions: A series booking taken, calls more than two days ahead
capabilities.effects: Guaranteed episodes paid when cut or called off, at the rate the payroll spreads them
capabilities.provenance: research-schedule-series-voice-commercial.json (2014 TV Agreement guarantees); an order cut's payment read from 'guaranteed', not found as a clause
capabilities.limits: Retired by the owner's scope reset of 2026-10-09; it was Verified. A series' calls can't be asked to move by the actor

capabilities.goal: A commercial's shoot or a voice session moved, its call moved, or called off
capabilities.preconditions: A commercial or voice booking taken
capabilities.effects: A commercial postponed pays half a session fee; called off, the booked fee; the rest waived the lesser of a fee and $500
capabilities.limits: Retired by the owner's scope reset of 2026-10-09; it was Verified. UK commercial and BBC audio cancellation clauses weren't found: SLATE's estimate, said so
